# The Untamed Kingdom

[Home](README.md) · [Getting started](getting-started.md) · [Magic](magic.md) · [Abyss Fruits](fruits.md) · [Companions](companions.md) · [Armour](armour.md) · [AI & simulation](ai-and-simulation.md) · [World events](world-events.md) · [The Untamed Kingdom](exploration.md) · [Dragonbound & Kingdoms](dragonbound.md) · [Mobs & bosses](mobs-and-bosses.md) · [Items & recipes](items-and-recipes.md) · [Progression](progression.md) · [Commands](commands.md) · [FAQ](faq.md) · [Development](development.md)

---

Since v1.1.0 the overworld is **a world of its own** - every region named, every region different, and something worth finding over every hill. The rolls all come from your world's **seed**: the same world always tells the same story, a new world a new one. Everything here is in the Handbook's **Atlas** too.

## Regions

The world is cut into **320 x 320-block regions**. Walk into one you have never seen and its name, realm and danger appear on your screen, with a line of lore in your chat - and you earn a little magic XP. A region's **name** is made from what its land is like (*Kelmoor Fen*, *the Peaks of Varowbarrow*, *the Whispering Pines*), read from the ground, trees and snow where you first walk in.

### Realms and danger

The farther from the world spawn, the wilder the land. Each region rolls its **danger stars** (1-5) around its realm's base. Stars push up the loot rarity, the number of landmarks, the chance of elites (and of Champions and Infernals), and the size of ambushes.

| Realm | Distance from spawn | Danger stars | Traits |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Noble Realm** | 0-600 blocks | 1 (±1) | 1 |
| **Common Realm** | 600-1500 blocks | 2 (±1) | 1 |
| **Forsaken Realm** | 1500-2800 blocks | 3 (±1) | 2 |
| **the Marches** | beyond 2800 blocks | 4 (±1) | 2 |

Past the Forsaken Realm lie **the Marches** toward the neighbouring kingdoms: the Spade Marches to the north, the Heart Marches to the east, the Southern Wilds and the Diamond Marches to the west. Marches regions may roll a third trait and an extra star.

### Traits

Each region rolls one or two traits (the land makes some likelier). They change what happens there:

| Trait | What it means | Likelier on |
|---|---|---|
| **Mana-Rich** | +30% mana regeneration. | any land |
| **Ley Line** | +10% spell power. | any land |
| **Wild Magic** | Spells may surge (free, or cast twice) - or misfire. | any land |
| **Haunted** | Hollow Knights and wraiths walk at night; ghost lights drift. | darkwood, swamp, taiga, plains, frozen |
| **Bandit Country** | Bandits roam and ambush travellers. | plains, savanna, desert, badlands, hills |
| **Devil-Scarred** | Imps lurk, and Devil Gates tear open more often. | badlands, desert, darkwood, swamp |
| **Wyvern Territory** | Wyverns roost in the heights and hunt overhead. | mountains, badlands, desert, frozen, hills, savanna |
| **Fae Wilds** | Sprites dance in fairy rings - mischievous, and generous. | forest, blossom, plains, jungle, mushroom |
| **Ancient Ruins** | The old kingdom's spires, crypts and obelisks lie thick here. | any land |
| **Sanctuary** | A quiet land: no ambushes, and wanderers come here to rest. | plains, blossom, forest |
| **Hoard-Rich** | Treasure maps and journals that mark buried caches turn up far more often. | desert, water, badlands |
| **Untamed** | Elites are twice as common - and drop better loot. | jungle, darkwood, mountains, frozen |

## Landmarks

Every region has **three to eight landmarks**, placed by the seed (never within 90 blocks of the world spawn, always 70+ blocks apart). What each is was decided when somebody first entered its region. A landmark is raised **as explorers come near** - out of sight (behind you, or far away) - fitted to the ground with a foundation, and its chests are filled with loot for its region's danger. Its **guards appear when you come close**, its **master** when you reach its heart. Walking up to one counts as finding it (the **Trailblazer** feat, the *Explore* mission, the Atlas).

| Landmark | Where | Danger | What is there |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Mage Spire** | any dry land | 2+ stars | A five-floor tower of the old kingdom - each floor guarded, the Spire Warden waiting at the top. |
| **Wyvern Roost** | mountains, badlands, desert, frozen, hills, savanna, taiga | 2+ stars | A nest of bones and gold where a Mana Wyvern (Ember, Frost or Storm) sleeps on its hoard. |
| **Ancient Catacombs** | any dry land | 1+ stars | A stair down into a maze of crypts - every one different - with a guardian at its heart. |
| **Ruined Hamlet** | plains, forest, savanna, taiga, hills, blossom, frozen | 1+ stars | A village nobody lives in any more - some are empty, some are not. |
| **Old Graveyard** | any dry land | 1+ stars | Tombstones, a crypt, and the Hollow who rise from it at night. |
| **Mana Obelisk** | any dry land | 1+ stars | An ancient obelisk that answers a prayer with a boon - or a curse. |
| **Fairy Ring** | forest, blossom, plains, jungle, mushroom, darkwood, taiga | 1+ stars | A ring of mushrooms where sprites bargain - your offering for a random gift. |
| **Ruined Watchtower** | any dry land | 1+ stars | A broken Magic Knight watchtower, now held by bandits - with a mana spawner. |
| **Wrecked Caravan** | plains, savanna, desert, badlands, forest, hills | 1+ stars | A broken cart and scattered cargo - and maybe the bandits who broke it. |
| **Star Crater** | any dry land | 1+ stars | Where a star fell long ago: mana crystals, a Star Fragment, and something guarding them. |
| **Colossal Bones** | desert, badlands, savanna, plains, frozen, hills | 1+ stars | The bones of something enormous, with a treasure hidden in its skull. |
| **Forgotten Battlefield** | plains, savanna, hills, taiga, frozen, badlands | 2+ stars | Old banners and broken grimoires where two armies died - the Hollow still fight here at night. |
| **Lost Waygate** | any dry land | 1+ stars | A ruined Mana Waygate of the old kingdom - touch it to add it to the network. |
| **Hedge Witch Hut** | swamp, darkwood, forest, taiga, jungle | 1+ stars | A stilt hut where a hedge witch lives - a trader, or a curse. |
| **Diamond Border Fort** | any dry land | 3+ stars | A crystal-crowned keep of the Diamond legions - Legionnaires on the walls and a Diamond Commander inside. |
| **Spade Citadel** | any dry land | 3+ stars | A black citadel of the Spade zealots, with a Spade Inquisitor at its heart. |
| **Heart Sanctum** | any dry land | 3+ stars | A spirit grove of the Heart Kingdom - its guardians are friendly, and its priestess trades. |

* **Mage Spires**: five floors linked by a spiral stair, each with its guards and its chest (better the higher you climb), Mana Spawners on three floors, and the **Spire Warden** on the roof. Defeat it and a treasure chest appears on the roof (a guaranteed Rare-or-better item and a Star Fragment).
* **Wyvern Roosts**: a rock mound with a nest of bone and gold. Which wyvern lives there depends on the land - **Ember** (desert, badlands, savanna), **Frost** (snow, taiga, mountains) or **Storm** (hills, plains, forest, jungle). It sleeps until you come within ~13 blocks, hurt it, or open its hoard.
* **Ancient Catacombs**: a mausoleum over a spiral stair down to **five to ten rooms**, laid out at random every time - crypts, libraries, treasure rooms, spawner halls, trap rooms with flame jets, prisons (free the captive Magic Knight and they may join your squad), shrines with an Obelisk Core - and the Guardian's hall at the far end.
* **Ruined hamlets**: a well and three to five ruins (cottages, a longhouse, a chapel, a farm, graves) - empty, held by **bandits**, haunted by the **Hollow** at night, or home to a **hermit** wanderer.
* **Old graveyards** and **forgotten battlefields**: at night the **Hollow Knights** claw out of the graves when you come near.
* **Mana Obelisks**: use the **Obelisk Core** to pray - once each. A boon (Blessing of the Ley: +20% spell power; Mana Font; a relic; Vigor; Wings of Wind; Revelation: the nearest hidden landmarks) or, more often the more dangerous the region, a curse (the Hollow rise, Mana Drain, Hex of Misfortune, Imps).
* **Fairy rings**: drop an item into the ring and the sprites trade it for a random gift - a relic, sprite dust, potions, a Star Fragment, or nothing at all. Three bargains a day.
* **Lost Waygates**: walk up to one and it joins your Mana Waygate network, named after its region.
* **Hedge witch huts**: a stilt hut whose witch is a friendly trader - or a cursed Champion with imps.
* **Wrecked caravans**: open the chest and half the time it was bait.

### Mana Spawners

The cage blocks in spires, crypts, watchtowers and catacombs call up foes (arcane, hollow, bandit or devil) every few seconds while you are within 20 blocks, up to four at a time. **Break the spawner** to stop it for good - it shatters into mana crystals and XP.

### Mimics

About one landmark chest in eight is a **Mimic**. Open it and it bites; slay it and it spills the loot it was hiding, plus **Mimic Teeth** (the Travelling Merchant pays 45 doubloons each).

## Random loot

Landmark chests, elites, bosses, wanderers and fairy rings hand out **rolled items**: a rarity, one to four random affixes, and a name. Danger stars, luck (relics) and a *Lucky Stars* omen push rolls up the rarity ladder.

| Rarity | Base weight | Affixes | Affix strength |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Common** | 50 | 1 | x1.0 |
| **Uncommon** | 28 | 1 | x1.35 |
| **Rare** | 14 | 2 | x1.7 |
| **Epic** | 6 | 2 | x2.1 |
| **Legendary** | 1.8 | 3 | x2.7 |
| **Mythic** | 0.2 | 4 | x3.4 |

Legendary and Mythic items get **names of their own** (*Velmora, the Ashen Promise*). Every rolled item keeps its roll in its lore.

### Relics

Relics work **from your hotbar** - up to **3** at a time, the first three from the left. Each kind favours some affixes:

| Relic | Description | Favours |
|---|---|---|
| **Signet Ring** | a ring cut with an old house's sigil | mana, regen, power, scholar |
| **Rune Talisman** | a stone tablet humming with a single rune | haste, ward, guard, mana |
| **Bone Idol** | a little carved idol of a forgotten god | vigor, thorns, leech, guard |
| **Crystal Eye** | a crystal that sees in the dark | sight, luck, power, fortune |
| **Wyvern Fang** | a fang that is still warm | might, leech, ember, thorns |
| **Spirit Feather** | a feather lighter than air | swift, leap, gills, regen |
| **Legion Prism** | a cut crystal from a Diamond commander's crown | power, ward, guard, might |
| **Zealot's Brand** | a black iron brand still warm from a Spade forge | power, leech, haste, thorns |
| **Spirit Blossom** | a flower that never wilts, from the Heart Kingdom | regen, vigor, mana, swift |

| Relic affix | At Common (scales with rarity) |
|---|---|
| `mana` | +8 max mana |
| `regen` | +6% mana regeneration |

### Rolled weapons

Vanilla swords and axes (stone to netherite by rarity) with affixes that work while held:

| Weapon affix | At Common (scales with rarity) |
|---|---|
| `sharp` | +6% damage |
| `burning` | sets foes ablaze (2s) |
| `frost` | 12% chance to freeze |
| `storm` | 5% chance to call lightning |
| `vampiric` | heal 4% of damage dealt |
| `mana_thirst` | +2 mana per hit |
| `executioner` | +15% damage below 30% health |
| `giantslayer` | +10% damage to bosses and elites |
| `cleave` | cleaves a nearby foe for 25% |
| `quick` | Haste while held |

### Reforging

Hold a relic or rolled weapon at a **Magic Forge** and choose *Reforge* to reroll its affixes (its rarity stays). The cost:

| Rarity | Mana crystals | Sprite Dust | Star Fragments |
|---|---|---|---|
| Common | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| Uncommon | 4 | 0 | 0 |
| Rare | 6 | 1 | 0 |
| Epic | 10 | 2 | 1 |
| Legendary | 16 | 3 | 2 |
| Mythic | 24 | 4 | 3 |

Old smiths' work turns up too: pieces of the armour sets, already **reinforced** (+1 to +3) and sometimes inscribed with a rune.

## Champions and Infernals

Elites come in three tiers - **Elite** (one trait), **Champion** (two) and **Infernal** (three) - and grow commoner with the danger stars. Champions drop doubled doubloons and a rolled item half the time; Infernals tripled doubloons, always a rolled item (Rare or better) and often a Star Fragment. See [Mobs & bosses](mobs-and-bosses.md#champions-and-infernals-v110) for every trait.

## Encounters

Some dangers you wake yourself:

| When | Chance | What appears |
|---|---|---|
| Chopping a log | 0.40% | The tree groans... a Rootwarden tears itself free of the bark! |
| Mining stone or ore below y 50 | 0.20% | The rock splits open - a Mana Wraith seeps out of the stone! |
| Cutting grass or flowers | 0.15% | Something giggles in the grass... |
| Using a bed at night | 5% | You wake with a start. A Hollow Knight stands over your bed. |
| Opening a landmark chest | 12% | The chest has TEETH! |
| Slaying a monster at night in Haunted land | 3% | Its spirit will not rest... |

Fae Wilds make sprites three times likelier and Rootwardens twice; Haunted land makes the bed visitor three times likelier. Once a minute the land itself may also send something: bandit ambushes in **Bandit Country** by day, the **Hollow** in **Haunted** land at night, **imps** in **Devil-Scarred** land, **wyverns** crossing the sky over **Wyvern Territory**, **sprites** by day and **Will-o'-Wisps** by night in the **Fae Wilds** (wisps also haunt Haunted land). Parties grow with the danger stars. **Sanctuaries** stay quiet.

* **Mana Sprites** may snatch an item from your pack (never the one in your hand) and fly off - catch one within a minute to get it back.
* **Will-o'-Wisps** drift ahead of you while you follow; at the end of the trail, a **hidden cache** - or a trap.
* **Rootwardens** snare you with roots; **Hollow Knights** cast dark and ice magic from their broken grimoires and burn in sunlight.

## Omens

Most mornings (60% of them) the sky shows an omen that colours the whole day:

| Omen | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Mana Tide** | The ley lines swell: +25% mana regeneration for everyone today. |
| **Wild Surge** | Magic runs wild today: spells may surge, or misfire, anywhere. |
| **Starfall** | Stars will fall tonight. Find where they land - each leaves a Star Fragment. |
| **Hollow Night** | The Hollow walk tonight: fallen knights rise across the land. |
| **Wyvern Migration** | Wyverns are on the wing today. Watch the skies. |
| **Merchants' Fair** | Wanderers are on every road, and the merchant sells for 20% less. |
| **Bandit Moon** | Bandits are bold today - and their purses are heavy. |
| **Fae Revel** | The fae are generous today: fairy-ring bargains favour you. |
| **Calm Skies** | A quiet day: no ambushes, and wounds heal faster. |
| **Lucky Stars** | Fortune smiles: loot is far likelier to roll a rarer item today. |

## Wanderers

Travellers walk the roads, more often in **Sanctuaries**, the **Noble Realm** and on a **Merchants' Fair** day, and move on after about twelve minutes. Each has a name of their own. Talk to one: they greet you, tell a **rumour** that points at a real landmark nobody has found yet, trade, and sometimes ask a **favour** - bring them something, or deal with a landmark (defeat its master or loot it) - for doubloons and often a relic.

| Wanderer | What they do |
|---|---|
| **Pilgrim** | Walks from shrine to shrine and knows every road. |
| **Cartographer** | Sells Explorer's Maps to the landmarks nobody has found. |
| **Peddler** | Trades odd goods - and now and then a relic. |
| **Hermit Mage** | Knows the old magic and sells spell scrolls. |
| **Bard** | Trades in tales - true ones point the way to treasure. |
| **Lost Knight** | A Magic Knight far from their squad, who may join yours. |
| **Quartermaster** | Runs the Royal Capital's war office: buys spoils of war, sells saddles and contracts. |
| **Heart Priestess** | Keeps a Heart Sanctum: trades spirit relics and draughts, and thanks friends with Heart Blooms. |

## Maps, journals and the Atlas

* **Explorer's Map** (cartographers, the merchant, chests; or craft paper around a compass): unroll it and it leads to the nearest landmark nobody has found. Hold it to follow the arrow; it crumbles when you get there.
* **Torn Journal Page**: read it for a page of someone's story - written from the land around you, naming real regions and landmarks. Some mark a **buried cache**: hold the page to follow the arrow and use it on the spot to dig.
* **Spire Core** (the Spire Warden's heart): use it and a Mana Waygate rises in front of you, already in your network.
* **The Atlas** (in the Handbook): your region, today's omen, the regions and landmarks you have found (nearest first), your relics at work - and *Track an unknown landmark* puts an arrow to it on your HUD.

| Item | What it is |
|---|---|
| **Explorer's Map**<br>`bc:explorer_map` | Leads you to a landmark nobody has found. Hold it to follow the arrow. |
| **Torn Journal Page**<br>`bc:journal_page` | Read it: a page of someone's story. Some mark a buried cache. |
| **Star Fragment**<br>`bc:star_fragment` | A shard of a fallen star. Reforges Epic and better relics and weapons. |
| **Sprite Dust**<br>`bc:sprite_dust` | Glittering dust shed by Mana Sprites. Used to reforge relics and weapons. |
| **Mimic Tooth**<br>`bc:mimic_tooth` | A tooth from a chest that bit back. Merchants pay well for them. |
| **Hollow Ember**<br>`bc:hollow_ember` | The last spark of a Hollow Knight's grimoire. Wanderers collect them. |
| **Spire Core**<br>`bc:spire_core` | The heart of a Spire Warden. Use it to raise a Mana Waygate in an instant. |

## Wyvernscale armour

A ninth armour set, forged at the Magic Forge from **Wyvern Scales** (needs the rank of the Wyvernscale set). See [Armour](armour.md).
